title: Confidentiality thread notes (scratch)
content:
Purpose: rough thread for confidentiality evidence + small experiments. Not for sharing outside trust-ops yet.

Topline thinking (short):
- Focus the next 2 sprints on artifacts that demonstrably show: data classification is applied, encryption-in-transit & at-rest, access reviews for system/service accounts, and formal onboarding/offboarding evidence.
- Keep proofs reproducible: commands, query snippets, console screenshots + timestamps.

Open questions / hypotheses to validate:
1) How tidy is our KMS key usage? we use AWS KMS for s3 & RDS encrypted at rest, but do we have one-to-one key metadata to map to customer data buckets? Need query.
   - ASK: SRE (Alex) for account-level KMS key alias list + tags. JIRA-SEC-1432 assigned.
2) Access reviews cadence: we claim quarterly for admin roles — can we produce the last 3 review logs? Where are they stored (confluence vs drive vs doc)?
3) Service account ownership: for long-lived keys, do we have owner + rotation proof? Some API keys found in vault look older than 1y.

Quick evidence checklist (confidentiality-focused):
- Data classification spreadsheet with sample rows (PII, internal, public).
- S3 bucket inventory + bucket policy screenshots showing encryption enforced.
- RDS snapshot metadata showing encrypted=true and KMS key id.
- KMS key list + tags (owner, purpose, rotation-policy).
- Vault secret engine audit events (creation/rotate/delete) for service accounts.
- SSO/OAuth admin logs: user provisioning/deprovisioning events for last 12 months.
- Access review artifacts: reviewer sign-off doc (quarterly).
- Change logs for IAM policy edits + PR link.

Evidence hunting commands (notes to self):
- aws s3api list-buckets --query 'Buckets[].Name' then for each: aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket <name>
- aws rds describe-db-snapshots --query 'DBSnapshots[?Encrypted==`true`].[DBSnapshotIdentifier,Encrypted,KmsKeyId]'
- aws kms list-keys -> aws kms describe-key --key-id <id> (careful with region)
- vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log
- okta: Reports -> System Log -> filter 'User deactivated' (export csv)

Short experiments to reproduce:
- Pull s3 bucket list + encryption status for 5Prod buckets and save output as evidence-s3-encryption-2026-02-20.txt
- Request KMS tag dump from infra (Maya) + cross-ref with bucket KmsKeyId -> produce mapping table.

Risk notes / uncomfortable spots:
- We have a handful of ephemeral test buckets in account X that are not in inventory. Need to run cross-account discovery.
- Some CI/CD runners write artifacts to an internal bucket with 'public-read' mistakenly set in one PR (old). Need to find historical ACL change and remediation log.
- Drift: some infra-as-code modules don't set SSE by default (old modules). Need a list of repos using legacy module.

Draft control mapping (very rough):
- CC1.1 (data classification) -> data-classification-sheet + sample labels (evidence: sheet + prod config export)
- CC2.2 (encryption at rest) -> s3 encryption, rds snapshots, kms key docs (evidence: CLI outputs + kms tag list)
- CC3.1 (access provisioning) -> okta org logs + onboarding checklist (evidence: onboarding playbook + system logs)
- CC3.4 (deprovisioning) -> offboarding workflow ticket + last 12 months deprovision CSV

Things to include in final artifact set (ordered):
1) Short narrative (1 pager) that ties each control to a specific artifact and an owner.
2) Raw exports (csv, txt) with timestamps and commands used.
3) Screenshots for UI-only things (okta, KMS console) annotated with why they matter.
4) A reproducibility script (bash) that re-runs the queries we used to gather evidence (redact secrets).

Notes-to-self / inbox items:
- Block 30m with Alex & Maya next week to pull KMS and S3 maps.
- Put a 'redaction' header in all raw exports (PII removal steps) — document the regex used.
- Draft 1-pager to PO for sign-off before we include artifacts in audit packet.

Random scraps / brainstorm ideas:
- Could we create a lightweight 'evidence collector' lambda that runs queries weekly and uploads timestamped bundles to a retention bucket (read-only for auditors)? Pro: reproducible; Con: needs infra changes.
- Automate a tag enforcement check in CI for any new infra PR that creates S3 or RDS resources.

Last run notes: 2026-02-20 I pulled a partial s3 encryption report for prod-* buckets (saved to /tmp/prod-s3-enc-20260220.txt). Results: 18/22 buckets show default encryption; need to check 4 buckets (names noted in local file).

Next steps (this week):
- Pull KMS key alias list (Alex) and KMS tag dump (Maya).
- Run OKTA system log export for provisioning/deprovisioning for 2025-2026 (Jordan).
- Identify any CI runners with long-lived creds and file a remediation ticket.

-- end (for now) --
